sections.title: Quick Answers to Common Inquiries
sections.description: Find immediate clarity regarding onboarding, data migration, and technical specifications.

lists.title: How fast can our team go live on the platform?
lists.description: Once your workspace is provisioned, your foundational pages, templates, and forms are live in under 5 minutes. You can begin publishing immediate updates through the CMS Studio.

lists.title: Is our organization's database completely isolated?
lists.description: Yes. Every tenant receives sovereign database boundaries and isolated encryption keys. Cross-tenant leakage is architecturally impossible.

lists.title: Can we connect our custom domain name?
lists.description: Absolutely. You can attach custom domains and subdomains with automatic SSL certificates generated and renewed seamlessly.

lists.title: What level of technical support is included?
lists.description: All standard workspaces include 24/7 ticket and email support. Enterprise tiers feature direct dedicated Slack channels and senior SRE hotline access.

pages.metaDescription: Browse answers to frequently asked questions about billing, deployment, security, and tenant customization.

sections.title: Answers to Your Most Common Questions
sections.description: Quickly find clarity on billing cycles, domain routing, custom styling, and enterprise security guarantees.

lists.title: How does monthly recurring billing work?
lists.description: Subscriptions are billed automatically on a 30-day recurring cycle. You can cancel or upgrade your plan anytime without termination fees.

lists.title: Can I export or backup our tenant data at any time?
lists.description: Yes. You have complete sovereign data ownership. Full database backups and content archives can be downloaded directly from your workspace admin portal.

lists.title: Are templates customizable after installation?
lists.description: Every installed template can be customized in the CMS Studio or through the Visual Editor, enabling custom CSS overrides, unique color palettes, and custom token layouts.

lists.title: How do inquiries submitted via website forms reach us?
lists.description: Inquiry submissions are immediately stored in your sovereign database and forwarded via real-time notifications to your official corporate inbox.

lists.title: What happens if our website experiences sudden viral traffic?
lists.description: Our containerized cloud mesh automatically provisions additional edge capacity in milliseconds to absorb traffic surges without performance degradation.

lists.title: How does Ozikol ensure spam protection on broadcast emails?
lists.description: The platform incorporates real-time keyword analysis, blacklist detection, and automated sender verification to protect your domain reputation.
